verdict.rationale: Wise's first-party materials claim global payments arrive "in under 20 seconds", which is well inside the story's one-minute bar. The marketing site hedges this as "most arrive in under 20 seconds", and a delivery-estimate API lets users see the expected arrival time for each transfer. Missing for 10: any guarantee for all corridors or currencies (the claim covers only "most" transfers), independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world arrival times, and business-specific speed documentation rather than consumer-facing marketing copy.
